notes: The 'rate per 100,000 ED visits' is a proportion of ED visits, so it is coded as binary/categorical, with count/rate for mean monthly counts. Year-over-year VRs within sex and age strata are period series by group, so the depth is comparison, not stratified. The facility restriction (CV <40%, >75% diagnosis completeness) is an exclusion rule.
view_issues: Table footnote says percent change in 'visits per week' while the table shows monthly means. The VR<1 wording is reversed. The text ranks 'pronounced decreases' by % change in counts, not VRs. Some subgroup year-over-year VRs (e.g., female 0–14, 2022–2023) are not significant despite 'decreased yearly'.
